title: Discovery-only physically interpretable sub-band contrast enrichment census
purpose: Search a finite, physically interpretable enrichment family between Z8 and the full Z16 water-content state using discovery states only, then freeze exactly one state-separating candidate before any held-out exposure.

base_coordinate.components: eight contiguous 20-cm pair means of the 16-cell theta profile

numerical_scale.justification: both a pair mean and a pair half-contrast are linear combinations whose sum of absolute theta coefficients equals one

candidate_family.form: Z8 plus any subset of G1..G8
candidate_family.full_subset_role: exact invertible reparameterization of Z16 full theta state; not a reduced-state success

collision_rule.candidate_distance: L_inf over all selected Z8 means and selected half-contrast components

deterministic_selection.primary: minimum number of added half-contrast components among zero-collision candidates
deterministic_selection.secondary: maximum minimum candidate_Linf among all cross-history pairs with full_theta_Linf > theta_floor

interpretation.if_selected_G_count_lt_8: freeze selected coordinate before held-out exposure; next workunit is held-out state-separation and predictive evaluation
interpretation.if_selected_G_count_eq_8: water-content-only interpretable family requires full Z16 state at this floor; close reduced family as discovery no-go before considering a qualitatively new state class
